commits.message:
fix: eliminate dead-air wait during simulation startup

- Add isEngineConnecting state that flips true immediately on trigger, false in finally (never hangs on errors)
- Move setIsRunning(true) to after backend responds so playback only starts once timeline is loaded
- Fire granular event-log messages at every API stage (UPLINK / GRAPH / ENGINE / TIMELINE)
- Add canvas overlay card with spinner + status copy while connecting
- Disable + spinner on scenario dropdown and play button during connect
- Paused banner now hidden while engine is connecting
